name: Chudways
source:
[i]Chudways[/i] is a parody of the British educational game [url=https://vndb.org/v61610?]Pathways: Navigating Gaming, the Internet and Extremism[/url].

The main character, Charlie, encounters a number of situations based around current political controversies, such as his sister meeting a transwoman in the girls' toilet, or seeing his friend post offensive comments on social media. In each situation the player can make a choice between a "chud" choice (right-wing) and a "model citizen" choice (left-wing). Depending on Charlie's choices, the game has one of several endings.
translation:
[i]Chudways[/i] 是对英国教育游戏 [url=https://vndb.org/v61610?]Pathways：导航游戏、互联网和极端主义[/url] 的模仿。

主角查理遇到了许多基于当前政治争议的情况，例如他的妹妹在女厕所遇到变性女人，或者看到他的朋友在社交媒体上发表攻击性评论。在每种情况下，玩家都可以在“chud”选择（右翼）和“模范公民”选择（左翼）之间做出选择。根据查理的选择，游戏有几个结局之一。
